question: For Revive, how should an NPC’s equipped gear work after death? UO moves it into the corpse, while D2 keeps monster combat stats separate from dropped loot. I recommend leaving that gear lootable and preserving its combat effects separately on the revived NPC.
userAnswer: Keep loot; preserve combat effects separately
approvedPolicy: Original equipment remains ordinary corpse loot. Revive preserves its captured combat effects independently; do not return or duplicate physical gear on the revived NPC.
scope: This decision approves the loot/effect separation. It does not certify current item-proc/stat integration or resolve native ability-clock activation semantics.
implementationScope: While the prepared accepted-death capture is selected, its original droppable equipped items are exempt from generic native-loot destruction. Existing fishing/protected-item rules remain separate. Capture is still gated with the unfinished learned Revive route.
